intro.en: Custom fine-pitch wire-to-board and compact sensor harnesses using project-approved 32AWG or other fine conductors.
intro.zh: 采用项目认可的 32AWG 或其他细导体制作细间距板端与紧凑传感线束。

knowledge.en: Fine geometry requires exact control of contact, wire, stripping, crimping, insertion and strain relief.
knowledge.zh: 精细几何需要准确控制触点、线材、剥线、压接、装壳与应力释放。

notes.en: Provide complete connector references, wire construction, circuit map, routing envelope and inspection limits.
notes.zh: 提供完整接口料号、线材结构、回路图、布线包络与检验限值。

delivery.en: Approve the crimp setup, sample, magnified inspection and electrical test records before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认压接设置、样品、放大检验与电气测试记录。

introduction.zh: 尺寸更小，工程定义不能更少

subtitle.en: Fine wire, micro terminals and controlled assembly
subtitle.zh: 细导体、微型端子与受控装配

lead.en: Define the complete miniature connection system.
lead.zh: 定义完整微型连接体系。
